defs.def: （用于否定句和疑问句，或与 if 连用的句子）在任何时候，从来

ex.s: Why did they vary ever so slightly from one instrument to the next?
ex.t: 为什么它们在不同乐器之间会有如此微小的差异？

ex.s: Ever watched your child try to get out of doing housework by making excuses?
ex.t: 有没有见过你的孩子找借口逃避做家务？

ex.s: Although my daughter didn’t win, she did help expose one of the worst pieces of advice I have ever given.
ex.t: 尽管我女儿没有赢，但她确实帮我暴露了我曾给过的最糟糕的建议之一。

ex.s: Do you ever get to the train station and realize you forgot to bring something to read?
ex.t: 你有没有过到了火车站才发现忘了带读物的时候？

ex.s: If I ever get trapped outside my house again, my local telephone box will, sadly, no longer be able to connect me with my keys.
ex.t: 如果我再被锁在屋外，可悲的是，我家附近的电话亭将不再能帮我联系到钥匙了。

ex.s: To me, that was the biggest thing ever and I soon learned the whole poem by heart, well prepared for our first rehearsal.
ex.t: 对我来说，那是有史以来最了不起的事，我很快就背下了整首诗，为我们第一次排练做好了充分准备。

ex.s: With gas prices rising and airport security lines snaking longer than ever, why not book your next domestic vacation on a train?
ex.t: 随着油价上涨和机场安检队伍排得前所未有的长，为什么不预订下一次国内旅行的火车票呢？

ex.s: It made the sweetest sound I'd ever heard!My heart was dancing along with its flowing tune.
ex.t: 它发出了我听到过的最悦耳的声音！我的心随着它流畅的旋律翩翩起舞。

ex.s: “Some people ask me, ‘So what’s the worth of artificial life?’ Do you ever think, ‘What is the worth of your grandmother?’”
ex.t: "有人问我，'那人工生命有什么价值？'你有没有想过，'你祖母的价值是什么？'"

ex.s: Not only did he run in with energy, but his ____7____ could be heard as loud as ever!
ex.t: 他不仅精力充沛地跑进来，而且他的____7____声音像往常一样响亮！

ex.s: Will Quantum Computers Ever Come into Being?
ex.t: 量子计算机会成为现实吗？

ex.s: Will Quantum Computing Ever Live Up to Its Hype?
ex.t: 量子计算能达到它的炒作程度吗？

ex.s: He then made a small wooden horse, which Sullivan considered the best New Year present ever.
ex.t: 于是他做了一匹小木马，沙利文认为那是史上最好的新年礼物。

ex.s: Little wonder the Federal Duck Stamp Program has been called one of the most successful conservation programs ever initiated.
ex.t: 难怪联邦鸭票计划被称为最成功的保护项目之一。

ex.s: My husband and I agreed they were the best fruit we had ever eaten.
ex.t: 我和丈夫一致认为这是我们吃过的最好的水果。

ex.s: Spot and Stripe are the first tiger cubs that have ever been born here.
ex.t: 全球范围内，动物园里有三分之一的苏门答腊虎幼崽活不到成年，所以我决定在家里全天候照顾它们。

ex.s: “We need artists . more than ever in our schools."
ex.t: 我们需要艺术家，学校里比以往任何时候都更需要他们。

ex.s: If the only reading you ever do is the novel or magazine, the speed at which you read -probably does not matter very much.
ex.t: 如果你唯一的阅读就是小说或杂志，那么你阅读的速度可能并不太重要。

ex.s: That said, to be honest the only people who ever ring our home phone are our Baby Boomers parents, to the point where we play a game and guess who is calling before we pick up the phone （using Caller ID would take the fun out of it）.
ex.t: 也就是说，老实说，唯一会给我们家座机打电话的人是我们婴儿潮一代的父母，以至于我们会玩个游戏，在接电话前猜是谁打来的（用来电显示会破坏这种乐趣）。

ex.s: If you ever get the impression that your dog can "tell" whether you look content or annoyed, you may be onto something.
ex.t: 如果你得到的印象是 你的狗可以"说" 无论你看起来满足或烦恼, 你可能会在的东西。

ex.s: In the movie Mission Impossible, Tom Cruise made being a secret agent seem like the coolest job ever.
ex.t: 在电影《碟中谍》里，汤姆·克鲁斯让做特工看起来像是有史以来最酷的工作。

ex.s: “If we're successful,” their mission statement reads, “we believe this will be one of the most important and widely beneficial scientific advances ever made.”
ex.t: "如果我们成功的话，"他们的使命声明写道，"我们相信这将是迄今为止最重要、最有益的科学进步之一。"

ex.s: Randall Flagg is one of the scariest characters ever.
ex.t: 兰德尔·弗拉格是有史以来最可怕的角色之一。

ex.s: No one will ever know what mix of talent, ambition, energy and luck made Dickens such a singular writer.
ex.t: 无人能知，是天赋、抱负、精力与运气的何种组合造就了如此独特的狄更斯。

ex.s: Thirty years later， a woman approached me in a public place． "Excuse me， did you ever enter a residence， long ago， thinking it was the McNay Museum？"
ex.t: 三十年后，一位女士在公共场所走近我。“打扰一下，你很久以前是否曾进过一户住宅，以为那是麦克奈博物馆？”

ex.s: These were the first pictures and first real paint and brushes Benjamin had  ever  seen.
ex.t: 这些是本杰明见过的第一批照片 和第一批真正的油漆和刷子

ex.s: Who knew if we’d ever see them again?
ex.t: 谁知道我们是否会再见到他们?

ex.s: When life seems like one long night,And nothing is ever going right,There's just one sure delight:Friendship, like sunrise, warm and bright.
ex.t: 当生活漫长得像一个无尽的夜晚，一切似乎都永远不对劲，只有一种快乐是确定的：友谊，像日出一样，温暖而明亮。

ex.s: Have you ever won any prizes before?
ex.t: 你以前得过什么奖吗？

ex.s: Have you ever participated in any of them?
ex.t: 你参加过其中任何一个吗？

ex.s: Scott Fitzgerald (picture 3) (picture 4) The Complete Rickshaw Boy SHERLOCK HOLMES Lao She (picture 5) (picture 6) Moment in Peking The ILIAD Lin Yutang Homer 1 Have you ever read any of these books?
ex.t: 斯科特·菲茨杰拉德（图3）（图4）《骆驼祥子》　《福尔摩斯》　老舍（图5）（图6）《京华烟云》　《伊利亚特》　林语堂　荷马　1 你读过这些书中的任何一本吗？

ex.s: I have made over 140 work trips, but my best work trip ever was to Broome in the Kimberley region.
ex.t: 我已经出差超过 140 次了，但最棒的一次出差是去金伯利地区的布鲁姆。

defs.def: （进行比较时用以加强语气）以往任何时候，曾经

ex.s: During your initial reading of material, do you ever go back and reread sentences or paragraphs?
ex.t: 在你对材料的初步阅读过程中,你是否曾经回去重新阅读句子或段落?

ex.s: working harder than ever before       D. relying on foreign architects
ex.t: 比以往任何时候都更努力地工作 D．依赖外国建筑师

ex.s: And I ____53____ myself harder than I ever had.
ex.t: 我比以往任何时候都更___53___地鞭策自己。

ex.s: As technology develops, young people are writing more than they ever have.
ex.t: 随着科技的发展，年轻人写的字比以往任何时候都多。

ex.s: Some people live with their elderly parents; many more adult children are returning to the family home, if they ever left.
ex.t: 有些人与年长的父母生活在一起;还有更多的成年子女返回家庭,如果他们离开的话。

ex.s: As we organized teams, prepared resources and practiced answering questions, I felt more connected than I ever had to any sports team.
ex.t: 当我们组队、准备资源并练习回答问题时，我感觉比以往任何时候都更融入任何一支运动队。

ex.s: It may be more dangerous than ever.
ex.t: 它可能比以往更危险。

ex.s: The likables’ plays-well-with-others qualities strengthen schoolyard friendships, jump-start interpersonal skills and, when tapped early, are employed ever after in life and work.
ex.t: 讨人喜欢的那种"善于与人相处"的品质加强了校园友谊，启动了人际交往技能，如果及早发掘，将在以后的生活和工作中一直发挥作用。

ex.s: The world is changing faster than ever.
ex.t: 世界变化的速度比以往任何时候都快。

ex.s: The word is changing faster than ever.
ex.t: 世界变化得比以往任何时候都快。

ex.s: If you want to tell the history of the whole world, a history that does not privilege one part of humanity, you cannot do it through texts alone, because only some of the world has ever had texts, while most of the world, for most of the time, has not.
ex.t: 如果你想讲述整个世界的历史，一部不偏袒任何一部分人类的历史，你就不能只依靠文字文献，因为世界上只有一部分地区曾经有过文字，而世界上大部分地区在大部分时间里都没有。

ex.s: Nothing in my life before prepared me ____58____ this one-and to be sure, the first time I came here I never imagined I would ever feel comfortable in this area.
ex.t: 我这辈子没有准备过这个____58____... 确定我第一次来这里... ...我从未想过我会在这片区域感到舒服

defs.def: all the time or every time; always 不断地；总是；始终

ex.s: If you’ve ever worked as an instructor, manager, trainer or coach, you’ll know that there are few better ways to learn new information than to teach it.
ex.t: 如果你曾担任讲师、经理、培训师或教练，你就会知道，学习新信息几乎没有比教给别人更好的方式了。

ex.s: 21．（10分）Some people live to climb the highest mountains． Some people live only dreaming about it while others live to avoid ever climbing at all． But one thing is certain， all people encounter mountains in their life．
ex.t: 21．（10分）有些人活着是为了攀登最高的山峰。有些人只活在梦想里，而另一些人活着则完全避免去爬。但有一件事是确定的：所有人一生中都会遇到山。

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: By the time 250,000 were on the bridge, engineers noticed something terrible：the roadway was flattening under what turned out to be the heaviest load it had ever been asked to carry.
ex.t: 等到25万人在桥上时，工程师们注意到一件可怕的事情：桥面在它迄今承载的最重负荷下变平了。

ex.s: And, having spoken to many of the world's foremost AI researchers, I believe there is good reason to doubt that we will see A GI any time soon, if ever:
ex.t: 而且，在和世界上许多顶尖AI研究人员交谈后，我确信有充分理由怀疑我们近期——甚至根本——不会看到AGI出现：

defs.def: （用于 when、why 等之后表示惊讶）究竟，到底

ex.s: Ever sinceD.
ex.t: 发现问题

ex.s: Ever since her childhood, Ginni, now 71, has had a deep love for travel.
ex.t: 从童年时起，现年71岁的金妮就对旅行有着深厚的热爱。

ex.s: A．ever sinceB．as if
ex.t: A．ever sinceB．as if
